entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I need to start a return for an order I placed a couple of months ago.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-21-B. It was for the Aero Race Jersey.

Got it, thank you. I'm pulling up the order now... okay, I see the Aero Race Jersey. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference, I suppose. It's the wrong size for me. I should have ordered up, because this jersey is just way too tight in the shoulders. I'd like to exchange it if possible, or just return it.

I understand completely, our race fit can be quite specific. Let me just confirm the delivery date for you... okay, I see it was delivered 63 days ago. That's no problem at all, you're still well within our 90-day return window for standard items.
Oh, perfect. So I can send it back?

Absolutely. I have approved the return for you. I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Once we receive the jersey, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.

That's great, thank you. Now, since I'll need to place a new order for the correct size and wait for shipping again, would it be possible to get a small discount code for the trouble? Maybe 15% off the new one?

I appreciate you asking, and I understand why you would. However, since this is a standard return for a sizing preference, my system doesn't allow me to generate goodwill discount codes. The policy is to provide the free return shipping and the full refund, which I've already set up for you.

I see. Okay, no discount code. What about a partial store credit on top of the refund, say $10, just to cover some of the new shipping cost? I'd be happy to place the new order for the exchange right now.

That is a thoughtful offer, but unfortunately, I'm not authorized to add credit for a sizing exchange. The best I can do is ensure your return is processed smoothly and you get your refund as quickly as possible so you can purchase the size that works best for you.
Alright, that's fair enough. The full refund and free return shipping is good enough for me. Thanks for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome! I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Will there be anything else today?
Great. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
